description: [Merchant] Download a READY export file. The export must be in READY status. Returns binary data for the file.

exportId.description: The export ID from the export request (UUID format)

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses production private key as default (Data API is production-only).

saveToFile.description: Whether to save the downloaded file to disk. If true, saves to /mnt/d/git/payware/mcp/downloads/. If false, only shows metadata/preview.

name: payware_data_download_export
